Feature: Independent control register for each GPIO
Test Description: Validates GPIO GP0 register block by checking masked default values and then performing masked write/readback across a list of registers. The test iterates through unresolved register macro addresses UNRESOLVED(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8) to UNRESOLVED(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_27), writes six data patterns using per-register write masks, and verifies readbacks using per-register read masks and expected values derived from defaults. Test passes only if no default or write/read mismatches are detected.
Remarks: When reading default values the DIN value can become 1 automatically if not forced; forcing zero to DIN may set level select high causing a read mismatch against expected.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1. Prepare the list of target registers using UNRESOLVED(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8) to UNRESOLVED(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_27) along with their per-register default values, read masks, and write masks.
2. For each target register: if not marked to skip for reset and readable by mask, read the register and compare the masked value (clearing bit 0) against its expected default value; record any mismatches.
3. For each of six data patterns, write the masked pattern to each target register that is writable and not skipped.
4. For each register written, read back with the read mask, compute the expected value using the write mask and default value, and compare; record any mismatches.
5. Pass if no default or write/read mismatches occurred; otherwise fail.

Validation / Acceptance Criteria: Pass if, for all registers UNRESOLVED(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8) through UNRESOLVED(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_27): (1) masked default read equals the corresponding expected default value; and (2) for each of the six data patterns, the masked readback equals the expected value computed from the write mask, read mask, and default. Otherwise, fail.
Meta Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
- Default check per i in [0..CNT-1]: data = (read_reg(addr_array[i]) & 0xfffffffe); pass if (data == default_value_array[i]); else def_fail_cnt++ and print failure.
- Write/readback check per pattern in {0xffffffff, 0xaaaaaaaa, 0x55555555, 0xf5f5f5f5, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xffff0000} and per i:
  - Preconditions: (skip_array[i] == 0) && (write_mask_array[i] != 0) && (read_mask_array[i] != 0).
  - data_rd = (read_reg(addr_array[i]) & read_mask_array[i]).
  - wr_n = (write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff).
  - exp_val = ((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i]));
  - Pass if (data_rd == exp_val); else wr_fail_cnt++ and print failure.
- Final decision: finish(1) if (def_fail_cnt > 0 || wr_fail_cnt > 0); else finish(0).
